f606W.note: 2026-09-13: masks a SECOND weakly-sheared background galaxy, object B, at dRA -3.67 dDec +1.43 (sky NW), r=3.94" -- distinct from the red object A at r=3.68" that the f814W note covers. Not an arc and not part of A. A and B have OPPOSITE colours (A redder than the deflector, B bluer: f606W/f814W relative to the lens 0.30 vs 1.42), which rules out the fold-pair reading two objects at the same radius would otherwise invite -- two images of one source must share a colour. Its tangential elongation (b/a 0.75 at 82 deg from radial in f814W, 0.56 at 70 deg in f606W) matches the 0.71 weak shear predicts at that radius for theta_E 1.35". B is faint (S/N 5-6) so the shape is noisy; the counter-image null and the radius carry the argument. B is detected in all three bands but is masked ONLY here -- add it to f814W when that mask is next touched.

f814W.note: 2026-09-13: the compact red object 3.68" from the deflector is NOT an arc and is masked.
